# ZOONAYMAN - TWO PLAYER SUBROUTINE - DREAMER 11 p.9 (PDF page 11) - add-on 03FA-04F6 (printed 03FA-0500)
# Needs 2K RAM. This file = the whole ZOONAYMAN (see zoonayman.txt) + 0206 = 13FA + the add-on rows,
# built as "Zoonayman (Two Player).d68" (0080-04F6, run C000).
# After the title the DREAM shows a 1/2 choice: key 1 = one player (normal game, jumps to 0208),
# key 2 = second player keys in the variables: FROM (1-6), TO (1-6), AT (1-5), each followed by a
# key-wait screen; an illegal key (0, 7, F ...) or an illegal operation (e.g. 5's to 5's) gives the
# guesser +1. Then the first player sees the throw and answers as in the one-player game.
# Corrections: none.
